description:
Leakage control system based on Regulation (EC) No 842/2006.

Leaklog is a leakage control system based on Regulation (EC) No 2024/573. It logs findings and parameters of leakage checks, shows a history of the development of parameters, compares them with nominal ones and calculates the percentage of leakage.
- Added Hungarian translation
- Added service company and inspector stamps to Inspection view, tables of inspections, and Operator Report
- Added Business Partners view for adding, editing, and removing partners, with contact details, website, and notes
- Added removal of refrigerant management records from the edit window
- Skipping inspections is now possible for multiple circuits at the same time
- Added a button for selecting starred circuits and a Place of operation column to the circuit selection window
- Added Unstar All Circuits menu command for the selected customer
- Circuits view now lists circuits grouped by customer when no customer is selected
- Refrigerant selection for circuits and repairs now lists only refrigerants recorded in the store
- Table headers now remain visible when scrolling
- Scroll position is now remembered when switching views
- Current search term now stays highlighted when switching views
- Added Enter and Escape key support to login, About, and language selection windows
- Fixed typos and grammatical errors in translations
